conversation.Statement: Good afternoon, this is Diana Lee from the Amazon Legal Department, badge ID ALD-90812. We are contacting you in accordance with Amazon Policy 14.3.8 regarding a recent alert on your account.
Hello? Yes, I am here. What is wrong on my Amazon?

Thank you for your prompt response. Our system detected a potentially unauthorized transaction for a MacBook Pro on your account this morning. For your protection, your account has been temporarily placed under review.
No, I not buy any MacBook. Why this happen?

I understand your concern. Sometimes, unauthorized parties gain access and place fraudulent orders. I will do my best to assist you in resolving this. May I verify your full name and the phone number linked to your Amazon profile, for authentication purposes?
Yes, it is Jun Park, and my number is 347-555-0198.
Thank you, Mr. Park. For additional security, could you also confirm your registered email address with us?
It is junp@email.com.
Perfect, thank you for confirming. I can now begin the account verification and fraud reversal process for you. Please remain calm; this is a standard precaution under Amazon Policy 22.4.2.
Okay, thank you. I am little nervous.
There is nothing to worry about, Mr. Park. We handle these situations every day. To continue, do you have access to a computer or smartphone where you can follow my instructions?
Yes, I have laptop but it is slow.
That is not a problem. Please open your browser and go to www.amazonsecurecheck.com, which is our authorized portal for account recovery.
I type it, but page is not loading fast.
Take your time, Mr. Park. Sometimes the secure connection takes a few seconds. Once the page loads, you should see a field asking for a verification code. Please let me know when you see that.
Yes, I see code box.
Excellent. For your safety, I am generating a secure code now: 624183. Please enter this code and press submit.
It is loading again. Oh, now it say 'secure connection established.'

That means the secure session is active. This will help us prevent any further unauthorized activity. Now, to proceed with the dispute, our policy requires a quick verification via your payment method. Are you able to access your online banking?
Yes, I can open my bank, but I am not sure how to use it well.
No problem, I will guide you step by step. Please log in to your bank, and confirm once you see your account overview. This will allow us to verify the refund destination.
Okay, I log in now. I see my balance.

Great, Mr. Park. For your reference, the unauthorized MacBook order was $1,799.99. We will initiate a refund, but due to system limitations, it may process as a partial amount initially, which can sometimes lead to an over-refund. If this occurs, we will need your cooperation to return the excess amount in accordance with Amazon Policy 9.1.12.
Wait, I get more money than I paid? Why this?

Occasionally, the automated system processes refunds incorrectly. If you receive more than the expected amount, we will contact you with instructions to return the surplus. This is a standard safety measure, and you will not be penalized as long as you cooperate.
Okay, I understand. What I do now?
Please keep your bank session open. Watch for any new credits to your account. If you notice a deposit larger than $1,799.99, notify me immediately so I can assist you with the necessary steps.
I see something now. It say $4,799.99 credit.

Thank you for informing me. It appears the system refunded $3,000 extra. According to Amazon Policy 15.5.1, we require you to return the excess funds today, using a secure payment channel. For international compliance, we use Amazon Gift Cards for refund reversal.
Gift card? I do not use before. Is okay for Amazon?

Yes, gift cards are the official method for resolving over-refunds in our policy. The process is secure and fully reversible. I will stay on the line to assist you with purchasing and submitting the codes.
But how many card I need? $3,000 is many.

You can purchase several Amazon Gift Cards in denominations of $500 each, totaling $3,000. These can be found at most supermarkets or online. Once you have the cards, simply read me the codes, and I will process the reversal instantly.
Okay, I can try. I go to store and buy.

Thank you for your cooperation, Mr. Park. If you have any questions at the store, let them know you are following official Amazon refund procedures. I will remain available if you encounter any issues.
I am back. I have six $500 cards.
Excellent. Please, one by one, read the claim codes printed on each card so we can process the refund reversal per Amazon Policy 15.5.1.
Okay, first code is AGC-4892-3847-ABCD.
Thank you. Please continue with the remaining codes.
Second code is AGC-5932-8374-BNQK. Third is AGC-3209-2938-CDEF.
Perfect, please provide the last three codes when you are ready.
Fourth: AGC-1837-9283-DJLE. Fifth: AGC-9832-3748-EHKS. Sixth: AGC-4823-7582-FJKE.
Thank you very much, Mr. Park. All codes have been received, and the over-refund has been corrected. Your Amazon account will be fully reactivated within 24 hours.
Okay, I hope is no more problem. Thank you for help.
You're welcome. Your patience and cooperation are greatly appreciated. Please contact us if you have any further questions. Have a safe and pleasant day, Mr. Park.
